Name: StardewPoker
Author: zerollzeng
Description:
---
  Description

  Play Texas Hold'em Poker right inside Stardew Valley! Sit down at the table with your favorite NPCs or invite your friends in multiplayer. Bet real in-game gold, bluff your way to victory, and watch NPCs play with strategies based on their personalities — Shane bluffs aggressively while Penny folds under pressure.

  ---
  Installation Instructions

  1. Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)
  2. Download StardewPoker_1.0.0.zip
  3. Extract the StardewPoker folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory
  4. Launch the game through SMAPI
  5. Press P in-game to open the poker table

  For multiplayer: all players need the mod installed with the same version.

  ---
  Main Features

  Texas Hold'em Poker
  - Full poker rules: preflop, flop, turn, river, showdown
  - Side pots, big blind option, proper min-raise rules
  - All-in runout animation with dramatic card reveals
  - Bet with real in-game gold — win big or lose it all!

  Play with NPCs
  - 35 NPCs available as opponents (all Stardew villagers + a special guest)
  - Each NPC plays differently based on their personality traits
  - Position-aware AI that bluffs, steals blinds, and makes pot-sized bets
  - NPCs that go broke are automatically replaced with new challengers

  Multiplayer Support
  - Host creates the game, friends join via invite notification
  - All players see the same table, sounds, and animations
  - Time freezes during poker so you never miss a day
  - Version check ensures all players run the same mod

  Customizable
  - Adjustable blind levels: 1/2, 5/10, 50/100, 500/1,000, 5,000/10,000, 50,000/100,000
  - Buy-in is 200x the big blind
  - Add NPCs one at a time — choose your opponents
  - Seats are randomly shuffled each session

  Stardew-Style UI
  - Pixel art oval poker table, wooden buttons, parchment panels
  - Easy-to-read card sprites with large rank and suit symbols
  - NPC portraits from the game, farmer mini portraits for human players
  - Win banner shows winning hand type (Straight, Flush, Full House, etc.)
  - Works on ultrawide displays (aspect ratio preserved)

  12 Languages
  English, Chinese (简体中文), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Spanish (Español), French (Français), German (Deutsch), Portuguese (Português), Russian (Русский), Italian (Italiano), Hungarian (Magyar), Turkish (Türkçe)

  ---
  Requirements

  - Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
  - SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
  - No other mods required

  ---
